model.description: His look. `body` picks his model slots from `bodies` and `head` picks his head from `heads`, with `hood` false switching to the head's `hoodless` model. `advisor` (body and head) is the vanilla campaign Advisor moved onto humanoid01 by generators.advisor_overhaul_model. The other bodies are vanilla humanoid01 outfits kept for later per-weapon armour. A weapon's own `body` picks its body, falling back to `body` here. `jade` is the Jade Wizard's old, long-bearded head.
model.head: advisor
model.prop_offsets_description: Weapon model -> [x, y, z] metres its model is moved in its own axes (x runs along the blade). Positive x slides the weapon blade first, so his hand sits further down the grip. Each one is written as a copy under the mod's props folder and used in place of the vanilla weapon. Set from the dashboard's Adjust panel.
model.hand_shift_description: [x, y, z] metres his hand and finger vertices move, in the right hand bone's bind frame (z flips for the left hand). Fitted against the vanilla Empire Captain so his fist closes around a weapon grip. Set from the dashboard's Adjust panel.

portrait.description: His 2D portrait art and his 3D portrait camera. `source` is the vanilla Advisor bust (pack, path) every image is cut from. `porthole` places it on the 300x164 porthole image and `card` on the 60x130 unit card (and the 120x260 info picture at twice the size), bottom aligned over a top-to-bottom gradient. `camera_head` replaces the head camera of the Grey Wizard's portrait settings: `z` is the distance and `y` the height above the head bone, in metres.

staff_and_sword.name: Staff and Sword
staff_and_sword.description: A walking staff for his spells and a plain Imperial blade for anything that gets too close.

missile.description: His staff bolt, a plain arcane bolt for now. Its element is meant to follow his first lore later, so the key names no element. `template` is the vanilla Hag Witch's staff bolt, with one bolt per shot instead of two, and `projectile` replacing the template's values. `ammo` is a little under the Hag Witch's 28.

upgrade.description: Bursting Bolts, the Staff apex reward. Five weaker bolts per shot instead of one, each bursting in a wide blue blast that spares his own side. The blast is the Blue Scribes' blue flame burst, as wide as the Poison Wind Mortar's blast and pushing harder, without its Warpflame.

art_1.name: Spellguard
art_1.description: He is slow and lightly armoured, so his wards do the work. Spells and arrows land softer on him.

art_2.name: Focused Bolt
art_2.description: He stops throwing the Winds and starts aiming them.

art_3.name: Long Reach
art_3.description: He casts from further back and carries more charges for the staff.

art_4.name: Wind Blast
art_4.description: When the enemy reaches him anyway, the staff blasts them back.

army_1.name: Hedge Wards
army_1.description: Small charms tied to every banner pole, against hostile magic.

army_2.name: Screen the Staff
army_2.description: His soldiers learn to stand between him and the enemy, and he keeps them covered in return.

army_3.name: Woven Wards
army_3.description: He threads a ward through every rank before the first blow.

apex.name: Channelled Staff
apex.description: The staff draws in the Winds and fires them back as five bolts at once.

army_4.name: Charged Steel
army_4.description: Before the lines meet he walks along them and touches every blade.

sword_and_shield.name: Sword and Shield
sword_and_shield.description: A sword and a knight's shield. He leaves the staff behind to stand in the front line.

art_1.name: Shield Wall
art_1.description: He stands where the blows land thickest and lets them come.

art_2.name: Turn the Arrow
art_2.description: He keeps the shield high, and arrows find wood instead of him.

art_3.name: Iron Body
art_3.description: He was never quick. He learned to be hard to kill instead.

art_4.name: Bulwark
art_4.description: He plants his feet, and nothing on the field can shift him.

army_1.name: Hold the Line
army_1.description: Men stand firm next to a man who will not step back.

army_2.name: Shields Up
army_2.description: He calls the volley before the archers loose.

army_3.name: Locked Shields
army_3.description: Every shield overlaps the next, the way he showed them.

apex.name: Shield of Faith
apex.description: His faith is not in any god. It is in the hope that this time will end differently.

army_4.name: Guardian
army_4.description: Whoever stands behind him is out of reach. He makes sure of it.

sword_and_bow.name: Sword and Bow
sword_and_bow.description: A hunting bow and a short blade. He was a fair shot long before he became a wizard.

missile.description: His bow. `template` is the vanilla missile weapon whose missile_weapons and projectiles rows are copied (the Huntsmarshal's arrow), with `projectile` replacing the template's values. `ammo` is the vanilla Ulrika's hero bow ammo. The arrow hits hard against both infantry and large targets.

upgrade.description: Hunter's Spread, the Bow apex reward. Six lighter arrows per shot instead of one, fanned out so they find more than one man in a block of infantry. Each arrow bursts in a small Hail of Doom blast that spares his own side, much smaller than the Staff's. The arrow is Markus Wulfhart's glowing arrow with the Hail of Doom trail, since Wulfhart's own trails draw ghost arrows beside a fan of arrows. The bonus against infantry and large targets is cut per arrow.

art_1.name: Steady Draw
art_1.description: He breathes out, and the arrow goes where he looked.

art_2.name: Hunter's Blade
art_2.description: When something big gets close, the short blade is ready.

art_3.name: Long Eye
art_3.description: He shoots from further out and faster, and carries extra arrows for a long hunt.

art_4.name: Executioner's Shot
art_4.description: One arrow, saved for the biggest thing on the field.

army_1.name: Huntsmen
army_1.description: He shows the archers where to aim.

army_2.name: Marked Ground
army_2.description: Every stone and stake is a range marker to him, and every cart carries spare shafts.

army_3.name: Trueshot
army_3.description: Archers near him shoot as if he were checking every shot.

apex.name: Hunter's Spread
apex.description: He nocks six arrows at once and looses them all.

army_4.name: Loose!
army_4.description: Nock, draw, loose. He counts it out until they no longer need him to.

greatsword.name: Greatsword
greatsword.description: A two-handed Imperial greatsword, far heavier than a wizard should carry. He swings it well enough.

art_1.name: Overhand
art_1.description: A blow from above, with all of him behind it.

art_2.name: Wide Arc
art_2.description: He swings to hit several men at once, not just one.

art_3.name: Cleaving Arc
art_3.description: One swing, three men. He has done the sums.

art_4.name: Headsman
art_4.description: A killing blow for anyone who stands in front of him too long.

army_1.name: Bloody Drill
army_1.description: He makes them practise until they stop flinching.

army_2.name: Charge Them
army_2.description: He goes first. They follow, and they keep swinging.

army_3.name: Through the Plate
army_3.description: He teaches them where the armour is thinnest.

apex.name: Whirl of Steel
apex.description: He stops choosing targets and lets the blade go round.

army_4.name: Butcher's Bill
army_4.description: He knows what this battle will cost, and makes the enemy pay it first.

glaive.name: Glaive
glaive.description: A long Cathayan glaive built to cut a horse out from under its rider, with a short sword at his hip for close work.

art_1.name: Horse Cutter
art_1.description: The glaive was made for one job: rider and horse, in one stroke.

art_2.name: Through the Barding
art_2.description: He finds the gap in a war beast's armour on the first try.

art_3.name: Turning Blade
art_3.description: The heavy head keeps moving after the cut, and whatever stands in its arc goes down with it.

art_4.name: Beastslayer
art_4.description: To him, monsters are just very large men. The glaive has the reach for them.

army_1.name: Long Arms
army_1.description: He teaches every unit where to stand when the big ones come.

army_2.name: Light Kit
army_2.description: Half the baggage, twice the marching. They arrive fresh.

army_3.name: Find the Gap
army_3.description: Every plate has a seam, and he shows his men where to find it.

army_4.name: Wall of Blades
army_4.description: He has seen this kind of charge before. He sets his line so it breaks on them.

apex.name: Ten Thousand Blades
apex.description: He fights like the glaive lines that once stopped an empire's cavalry, all on his own.

iron_hand.name: Iron Hand
iron_hand.description: No weapon at all. He fights with open hands and the weight of a forge behind every blow, the way the dragon-blooded lords of Cathay do.

dragon.name: Dragon Form
dragon.description: He lets the old shape take him: iron scales, a forge-hot breath, wings over the field. The Iron Dragon of Cathay, as he remembers it.

human.name: Human Form
human.description: He folds the dragon away and stands as a man again, open hands and an unbending stance.

art_1.name: Iron Skin
art_1.description: Blows ring off him like a hammer off an anvil.

art_2.name: Forge Palm
art_2.description: An open hand that lands with the weight of a falling ingot.

art_3.name: Hammer Hands
art_3.description: Each strike falls like the smith's hammer, and the men around the one he hits feel it too.

art_4.name: Unbending
art_4.description: He takes the hit and does not move a step. Neither do the ones who stand with him.

army_1.name: Foundry Drill
army_1.description: He works his soldiers like iron, heat and hammer, and they learn faster from every fight.

army_2.name: Tempered Ranks
army_2.description: Broken units are mended and sent back to the line, harder than before.

army_3.name: Old Hands
army_3.description: New recruits are put next to his veterans from the first day, and they learn fast.

army_4.name: Cast in Iron
army_4.description: He drills every unit like the company he once led. They take a blow the way iron takes the hammer.

apex.name: Battering Ram
apex.description: He stops fighting the line and walks through it. Nothing knocks him down, men are thrown aside, and every blow cracks armour. On foot he counts as a large target.

apex_form.name: Battering Ram
apex_form.description: Nothing stops or knocks him down. He bowls men over and flings them aside, and every blow cracks the armour of what it hits. He counts as a large target.

foot.name: On Foot
foot.description: He walks, as he always has.

warhorse.name: Barded Warhorse
warhorse.description: An armoured Imperial charger, trained not to shy at spellfire.

pegasus.name: Imperial Pegasus
pegasus.description: A winged Imperial steed that carries him over the enemy line.

disc.name: Disc of Tzeentch
disc.description: A floating daemon disc of Tzeentch. He does not talk about what he paid for it.

carmine_dragon.name: Carmine Dragon
carmine_dragon.description: A blood-red dragon of the old Empire. It has seen more endings than he has.

arts_art_1_stance.name: Art I: Stance
arts_art_1_stance.description: "Get your feet right. Everything else follows from the feet."\\n\\nWhat it does follows the weapon in his hands. Use Change Loadout to see the new effects.

arts_art_2_edge.name: Art II: Edge
arts_art_2_edge.description: With his footing settled, he learns where each blow does the most harm.\\n\\nWhat it does follows the weapon in his hands. Use Change Loadout to see the new effects.

arts_art_3_flow.name: Art III: Flow
arts_art_3_flow.description: Attack and guard stop being separate moves. Each one runs straight into the next.\\n\\nWhat it does follows the weapon in his hands. Use Change Loadout to see the new effects.

arts_art_4_ending.name: Art IV: Ending
arts_art_4_ending.description: "Every fight has a last blow. Make sure it is yours."\\n\\nWhat it does follows the weapon in his hands. Use Change Loadout to see the new effects.

arts_army_1_drill.name: Army I: Drill
arts_army_1_drill.description: The soldiers near him copy how he stands and moves, and fight better for it.\\n\\nWhat it does follows the weapon in his hands. Use Change Loadout to see the new effects.

arts_army_2_formation.name: Army II: Formation
arts_army_2_formation.description: He sets out the line to suit the way he fights.\\n\\nWhat it does follows the weapon in his hands. Use Change Loadout to see the new effects.

arts_army_3_last_stand.name: Army III: Last Stand
arts_army_3_last_stand.description: "Hold here. I have seen what happens to the ones who run."\\n\\nWhat it does follows the weapon in his hands. Use Change Loadout to see the new effects.

apex_master_of_arms.name: Master of Arms
apex_master_of_arms.description: In other lives he mastered each of these weapons in turn. Now he no longer has to choose.\\n\\nStacks with any other Apex or the Polymath.\\n\\nWhat it does follows the weapon in his hands. Use Change Loadout to see the new effects.

magic_deep_reserves.name: Deep Reserves
magic_deep_reserves.description: Long practice lets him gather and hold more of the Winds than most wizards can.

combat_steady_hands.name: Steady Hands
combat_steady_hands.description: "Slowly. A rushed spell is how the world ended last time."

apex_archmage.name: Apex: Archmage
apex_archmage.description: He has studied every lore there is across many lives, and all of it is within reach now.\\n\\nEach turn his army gains one random cataclysm spell, a memory of how some world ended.\\n\\nLocks the Polymath and every other Apex.

hero_assassinate.name: Assassinate
hero_assassinate.description: He picks out the enemy agent who will cause the most trouble later, and deals with them now.

hero_wound.name: Wound
hero_wound.description: "I do not need him dead. I need him out of the way for a while."

hero_assassinate_lord.name: Assassinate Lord
hero_assassinate_lord.description: Even generals have to sleep somewhere. He knows where.

hero_damage_walls.name: Damage Walls
hero_damage_walls.description: He weakens the mortar and cracks the stone, so the walls come down faster when the siege starts.

hero_assault_garrison.name: Assault Garrison
hero_assault_garrison.description: He slips into the settlement and strikes at the garrison before it can form up.

hero_damage_building.name: Damage Building
hero_damage_building.description: A fire in the right storehouse can do more damage than a whole army.

hero_block_army.name: Block Army
hero_block_army.description: Cut ropes, lamed horses and lost orders. The enemy army goes nowhere.

hero_hinder_replenishment.name: Hinder Replenishment
hero_hinder_replenishment.description: He spoils their supplies and turns away their recruits, so their losses stay unfilled.

hero_assault_units.name: Assault Units
hero_assault_units.description: He strikes the enemy camp at night and leaves several units bloodied by morning.

hero_scouting.name: Scouting
hero_scouting.description: He goes ahead of the army and comes back with what is waiting there.

hero_training.name: Training
hero_training.description: He drills the troops himself, and they learn faster for it.

hero_replenish_troops.name: Replenish Troops
hero_replenish_troops.description: He knows where to find fresh recruits and how to bring them into the ranks quickly.

hero_increase_mobility.name: Increase Mobility
hero_increase_mobility.description: He clears the road ahead and finds the quickest route for the army.

hero_scavenge.name: Scavenge
hero_scavenge.description: After the battle he makes sure nothing useful is left lying on the field.

hero_spread_public_order.name: Spread Public Order
hero_spread_public_order.description: "Be glad of what you have. I have seen the alternative."

hero_cleanse_corruption.name: Cleanse Corruption
hero_cleanse_corruption.description: He finds the taint early and burns it out before it can take hold.

hero_stimulate_growth.name: Stimulate Growth
hero_stimulate_growth.description: He knows which crops will fail and which fields will yield, and the province grows.

hero_increase_trade.name: Increase Trade
hero_increase_trade.description: He knows which roads will stay safe and which ships will come home.

hero_boost_income.name: Boost Income
hero_boost_income.description: His advice on taxes and trade puts more gold in the treasury.

hero_steal_technology.name: Steal Technology
hero_steal_technology.description: He reads their scholars' notes and brings home the parts worth having.

apex_last_sword.name: Apex: The Last Sword
apex_last_sword.description: In one ending he was the last man still fighting. He trains as if it will happen again.\\n\\nLocks the Polymath and every other Apex.

apex_power_behind_thrones.name: Apex: Power Behind Thrones
apex_power_behind_thrones.description: Across many lives he has advised kings, emperors and warlords. Every court he serves runs better for it.\\n\\nLocks the Polymath and every other Apex.

actions_default.name: Default Actions
actions_default.description: The hero actions he always has: Scouting, Scout Settlement and Boost Income.

memory_seen_the_end.name: Memory: Seen the End
memory_seen_the_end.description: In another life he watched this army walk into an ambush. He reads the ground ahead much more closely now.

memory_old_lessons.name: Memory: Old Lessons
memory_old_lessons.description: He learned every lesson the hard way, many times over. Teaching them, and picking up new ones, comes easily.

memory_calm_voice.name: Memory: Calm Voice
memory_calm_voice.description: He stopped being afraid of anything a long time ago, and the soldiers near him can tell.

memory_weight_of_years.name: Memory: The Weight of Years
memory_weight_of_years.description: He has died before. He did not care for it, and he takes more killing now.

memory_every_mistake_already_made.name: Memory: Every Mistake Already Made
memory_every_mistake_already_made.description: "I have made every mistake there is to make. I do not plan to make them twice."

polymath.name: Polymath: Everything, Again
polymath.description: In different lives he was a swordsman, a sorcerer, a spy and a steward. This time he means to be all four.\\n\\nA discipline counts once he knows 5 of its skills: Arts, Memory, Magic (learned spells count) and Hero work. Every discipline that counts makes every lord and hero in his faction stronger, and all four make them the strongest they can be.\\n\\nLocks every Apex.

long_patience_skill_dump.name: The Long Patience
long_patience_skill_dump.description: Once every other skill is learned, the rest of his time goes into slow, steady practice.

memory_ending_of_fire.name: Memory: The Ending of Fire
memory_ending_of_fire.description: In one ending the sky burned for nine days. His blade still carries the heat.\\n\\nLocks the other Endings.

memory_ending_of_plague.name: Memory: The Ending of Plague
memory_ending_of_plague.description: In one ending the cities emptied one by one from sickness. Some of it stayed with him.\\n\\nLocks the other Endings.

memory_ending_of_silence.name: Memory: The Ending of Silence
memory_ending_of_silence.description: In one ending the enemy came without a sound, and whole armies vanished. He learned to shake men before the blow lands.\\n\\nLocks the other Endings.

memory_ending_of_drowning.name: Memory: The Ending of Drowning
memory_ending_of_drowning.description: In one ending the sea rose over the walls. He learned to keep his head and his shield up while everything else went under.\\n\\nLocks the other Endings.

memory_ending_of_hunger.name: Memory: The Ending of Hunger
memory_ending_of_hunger.description: In one ending the granaries were empty before the first battle. He learned to wear his enemies down the way hunger wears down a city.\\n\\nLocks the other Endings.

magic_spellweavers_focus.name: Spellweaver's Focus
magic_spellweavers_focus.description: He keeps his mind on the spell, whatever is happening around him.

magic_quick_recitation.name: Quick Recitation
magic_quick_recitation.description: He has spoken these incantations so often that the words come without thought.

combat_warded_mind.name: Warded Mind
combat_warded_mind.description: He has been on the wrong end of enough spells to know how to shrug one off.

magic_open_channel.name: Open Channel
magic_open_channel.description: The Winds of Magic gather around him faster than around most wizards.

magic_overcast_discipline.name: Overcast Discipline
magic_overcast_discipline.description: "Push a spell past its limit, then let go before it bites back."

combat_arcane_ward.name: Arcane Ward
combat_arcane_ward.description: A standing ward he renews each morning. Blows that should land often slide off.

combat_spell_and_steel.name: Spell and Steel
combat_spell_and_steel.description: He fights with a sword in one hand and casts with the other, and each makes the other stronger.

arts_final_style_of_his_own.name: A Style of His Own
arts_final_style_of_his_own.description: Six weapons, six teachers, and a lifetime with each. He has taken the best of all of them and made it his own.

combat_ironbound_sleeves.name: Ironbound Sleeves
combat_ironbound_sleeves.description: Iron bands sewn into his sleeves let him beat a blade aside and strike back in the same move.

combat_duelling_wards.name: Duelling Wards
combat_duelling_wards.description: A small ward on his blade and wrist turns aside blows that would otherwise land.

combat_steel_in_the_weave.name: Steel in the Weave
combat_steel_in_the_weave.description: He puts a little of the Winds behind every cut, and it bites deeper.

combat_final_blade_of_the_winds.name: Blade of the Winds
combat_final_blade_of_the_winds.description: In another life the Winds themselves guided his sword. He still fights that way, and the men near him fight better for it.

combat_veterans_hide.name: Veteran's Hide
combat_veterans_hide.description: Old scars and well-worn armour. Blows that would cut a younger man leave him bruised.

combat_final_unbroken.name: Unbroken
combat_final_unbroken.description: He has been the last man left on the field more than once. He no longer knows how to run, and the men near him take heart from it.

combat_practised_aim.name: Practised Aim
combat_practised_aim.description: Endless practice with the bow. He shoots harder and nocks the next arrow sooner.

combat_piercing_shot.name: Piercing Shot
combat_piercing_shot.description: "Aim for the buckle. That is where the armour ends."

combat_long_sight.name: Long Sight
combat_long_sight.description: He picks out targets at ranges where most archers would not bother to draw.

combat_deep_quiver.name: Deep Quiver
combat_deep_quiver.description: He carries more arrows than most archers think worth the weight.

combat_final_storm_of_needles.name: Storm of Needles
combat_final_storm_of_needles.description: He shoots faster and further than ever, and the archers near him learn to keep up.

magic_quiet_mind.name: Quiet Mind
magic_quiet_mind.description: With a calm mind, he can ready his next spell sooner.

magic_second_wind.name: Second Wind
magic_second_wind.description: He has learned to store more of the Winds for the long fights.

magic_final_well_remembers.name: The Well Remembers
magic_final_well_remembers.description: Across many lives he has drawn on the same deep well of magic. It comes to him easily now.

magic_steady_cadence.name: Steady Cadence
magic_steady_cadence.description: He casts to a steady rhythm of word and breath, and wastes less of the Winds on each spell.

magic_final_conduit_unbound.name: Conduit Unbound
magic_final_conduit_unbound.description: He no longer fights the Winds for every drop of power. He lets them flow through him and spends them freely.

magic_wider_weave.name: Wider Weave
magic_wider_weave.description: He learns to stretch the same Winds further, so each spell costs him less.

magic_sharper_weave.name: Sharper Weave
magic_sharper_weave.description: He keeps tight hold of every thread of a spell, so very little goes wrong.

magic_final_weave_beyond_sight.name: Weave Beyond Sight
magic_final_weave_beyond_sight.description: Lifetimes of study let him read the Winds more clearly than any living mage, and see further by them.

hero_pathfinder.name: Pathfinder
hero_pathfinder.description: He leads the army by paths the maps do not show.

hero_foragers_eye.name: Forager's Eye
hero_foragers_eye.description: He knows what is worth taking from a beaten army, and where they hid it.

hero_final_hand_in_every_pocket.name: A Hand in Every Pocket
hero_final_hand_in_every_pocket.description: He has run spy networks across many lives. Doors open for him, secrets reach him, and enemies walk into his ambushes.

hero_final_banner_remembered.name: The Banner Remembered
hero_final_banner_remembered.description: He has watched armies fall apart in other lives and learned why. His stay fed, paid and in good heart.

hero_final_lamp_in_the_window.name: The Lamp in the Window
hero_final_lamp_in_the_window.description: Across many lives he has helped so many people that his name is welcome everywhere. Towns grow calmer and richer where he passes.

combat_shell_of_light.name: Shell of Light
combat_shell_of_light.description: A shield of pure magic hangs in the air around him and soaks up blows.

combat_mended_shell.name: Mended Shell
combat_mended_shell.description: When his magic shield breaks, it comes back sooner and stronger.

magic_hex_of_misfire.name: Hex of Misfire
magic_hex_of_misfire.description: He curses the enemy's casters, so their spells cost more and go wrong more often.

magic_arcane_conduit.name: Arcane Conduit
magic_arcane_conduit.description: He opens himself to the Winds and draws them in faster than a wizard should.

combat_warden_of_the_shell.name: Warden of the Shell
combat_warden_of_the_shell.description: He can mend the magic barriers of the men around him in the middle of a fight.

corruption_spread_chaos.name: Spread Chaos Corruption
corruption_spread_chaos.description: He carries the taint of the Dark Gods with him, and the land around him sours.

corruption_spread_khorne.name: Spread Khorne Corruption
corruption_spread_khorne.description: Skulls on the roadsides, blood in the wells. The Blood God's mark follows him.

corruption_spread_nurgle.name: Spread Nurgle Corruption
corruption_spread_nurgle.description: Flies, rot and slow fevers follow him. The Plague God's gifts spread where he walks.

corruption_spread_slaanesh.name: Spread Slaanesh Corruption
corruption_spread_slaanesh.description: Strange music, sweet smells and restless dreams follow him. The Dark Prince's touch spreads where he goes.

corruption_spread_tzeentch.name: Spread Tzeentch Corruption
corruption_spread_tzeentch.description: Things shift and change where he passes. The Changer's mark spreads in his wake.

corruption_spread_skaven.name: Spread Skaven Corruption
corruption_spread_skaven.description: Warpstone dust in the grain and scratching in the walls. The Horned Rat's taint follows him.

corruption_spread_vampiric.name: Spread Vampiric Corruption
corruption_spread_vampiric.description: Graves stir and the nights grow longer where he stays. The taint of undeath spreads from him.

corruption_final_corrupting_presence.name: A Corrupting Presence
corruption_final_corrupting_presence.description: He has learned to carry every kind of corruption at once. Wherever he stays, all of them spread faster.

corruption_taint_remembered.name: The Taint Remembered
corruption_taint_remembered.description: He has watched every kind of corruption take hold of a land, and learned how to keep it out. In his own provinces it takes hold more slowly.

combat_weight_of_the_charge.name: Weight of the Charge
combat_weight_of_the_charge.description: He learned to charge from a knight, and hits the enemy line with his full weight.

combat_long_breath.name: The Long Breath
combat_long_breath.description: "Pace yourself. The battle will still be there in an hour."

combat_flesh_remembers.name: Flesh Remembers
combat_flesh_remembers.description: His body takes well to healing magic and recovers more from it.

hero_students_in_every_court.name: Students in Every Court
hero_students_in_every_court.description: Many captains and wizards learned from him in other lives. New recruits arrive already knowing his lessons.

combat_light_along_the_line.name: Light Along the Line
combat_light_along_the_line.description: He spreads his magic shield across every unit in his army.

arts_army_4_every_banner.name: Army IV: Every Banner
arts_army_4_every_banner.description: Every army he marched with in other lives taught him something. Now his men learn all of it.\\n\\nWhat it does follows the weapon in his hands. Use Change Loadout to see the new effects.

arts_final_host_of_his_own.name: A Host of His Own
arts_final_host_of_his_own.description: His soldiers fight the way he taught them, whatever weapon he carries that day.

wh_main_lore_fire.name: Lore of Fire
wh_main_lore_fire.description: Aqshy, the Wind of Fire. It was the first magic he ever touched, and it burned him.

wh_dlc03_lore_beasts.name: Lore of Beasts
wh_dlc03_lore_beasts.description: Ghur, learned from a beastmaster in a life where men lost the war.

wh_main_lore_metal.name: Lore of Metal
wh_main_lore_metal.description: Chamon, the Wind of metal, learned in the workshops of the Gold College.

wh_main_lore_heavens.name: Lore of the Heavens
wh_main_lore_heavens.description: Azyr. He learned to read the stars, and then to bring them down.

wh_main_lore_light.name: Lore of Light
wh_main_lore_light.description: Hysh, learned in a temple that kept its lamps lit to the very end.

wh_dlc05_lore_life.name: Lore of Life
wh_dlc05_lore_life.description: Ghyran. He once grew a garden on a dead world, just to see if he could.

wh_dlc05_lore_shadows.name: Lore of Shadows
wh_dlc05_lore_shadows.description: Ulgu, the lore of being somewhere other than where the enemy is looking.

wh_main_lore_death.name: Lore of Death
wh_main_lore_death.description: Shyish. Few wizards know death as well as a man who has died more than once.

wh2_main_lore_high_magic.name: High Magic
wh2_main_lore_high_magic.description: Qhaysh, taught by an elf who outlived her island by a hundred years.

wh3_main_lore_of_ice.name: Lore of Ice
wh3_main_lore_of_ice.description: The cold of the far north, learned from the Ice Witches of Kislev.

wh3_main_lore_of_tempest.name: Lore of Tempest
wh3_main_lore_of_tempest.description: Storm magic. He learned to call lightning by standing in it.

wh3_main_lore_of_yang.name: Lore of Yang
wh3_main_lore_of_yang.description: Half of Cathay's magic of balance. The Lore of Yin is the other half.

wh3_main_lore_of_yin.name: Lore of Yin
wh3_main_lore_of_yin.description: The other half of Cathay's magic of balance. He has never managed to hold both at once.

wh3_dlc27_lore_mists.name: Lore of Mists
wh3_dlc27_lore_mists.description: Sea-fog spells, learned on a coast that sank under the waves.

wh3_dlc24_lore_hag.name: Lore of the Hag
wh3_dlc24_lore_hag.description: Old witchcraft from the far north, bought at a price he is still paying.

wh2_main_lore_dark_magic.name: Dark Magic
wh2_main_lore_dark_magic.description: Dhar, raw and dangerous. He knows exactly what it does to the one who uses it, and uses it anyway.

wh_main_lore_vampires.name: Lore of Vampires
wh_main_lore_vampires.description: Taught by a vampire count who wanted company for the long dark.

wh3_dlc29_lore_undeath.name: Lore of Undeath
wh3_dlc29_lore_undeath.description: The Great Necromancer's own words, learned in a world where Nagash won.

wh2_dlc09_lore_nehekhara.name: Lore of Nehekhara
wh2_dlc09_lore_nehekhara.description: Incantations a liche priest taught him in exchange for a name.

wh2_dlc11_lore_deep.name: Lore of the Deep
wh2_dlc11_lore_deep.description: Drowned magic, learned aboard a ship crewed by the dead.

wh_main_lore_big_waaagh.name: Big Waaagh!
wh_main_lore_big_waaagh.description: Orc magic. It should not work for a man, and nobody can explain why it does.

wh_main_lore_lil_waaagh.name: Little Waaagh!
wh_main_lore_lil_waaagh.description: Goblin magic, learned by losing a lot of card games.

wh3_dlc23_lore_hashut.name: Lore of Hashut
wh3_dlc23_lore_hashut.description: Fire and darkness from the priests of Hashut. He does not care to say how he learned it.

wh2_main_lore_ruin.name: Lore of Ruin
wh2_main_lore_ruin.description: Warp lightning, learned from a grey seer who thought him harmless.

wh2_main_lore_plague.name: Lore of Plague
wh2_main_lore_plague.description: He caught it once. He got better. Nobody else did.

wh2_dlc14_lore_stealth.name: Lore of Stealth
wh2_dlc14_lore_stealth.description: The tricks of Clan Eshin, learned by spending ten years as their target.

wh3_main_lore_nurgle.name: Lore of Nurgle
wh3_main_lore_nurgle.description: Grandfather Nurgle offered him his gifts. He turned them down and kept the spells.

wh3_main_lore_slaanesh.name: Lore of Slaanesh
wh3_main_lore_slaanesh.description: Slaanesh tempted him too. Saying no was harder this time, but he kept the spells.

wh3_main_lore_of_great_maw.name: Lore of the Great Maw
wh3_main_lore_of_great_maw.description: Gut-magic from the Ogre camps, earned by eating what they ate.

wh_dlc03_lore_wild.name: Lore of the Wild
wh_dlc03_lore_wild.description: The songs of the beastmen's herdstones. He learned them by listening from the trees.

wh2_dlc17_lore_rune.name: Lore of Runes
wh2_dlc17_lore_rune.description: A runesmith taught him three runes before the last hold fell. He worked out the rest.

polymath_0.name: Polymath: Everything, Again (0 of 4)
polymath_0.description: He draws on none of his 4 disciplines yet. Each discipline counts once he knows 5 of its skills.

polymath_1.name: Polymath: Everything, Again (1 of 4)
polymath_1.description: He draws on 1 of his 4 disciplines. Each discipline counts once he knows 5 of its skills.

polymath_2.name: Polymath: Everything, Again (2 of 4)
polymath_2.description: He draws on 2 of his 4 disciplines. Each discipline counts once he knows 5 of its skills.

polymath_3.name: Polymath: Everything, Again (3 of 4)
polymath_3.description: He draws on 3 of his 4 disciplines. Each discipline counts once he knows 5 of its skills.

polymath_4.name: Polymath: Everything, Again (4 of 4)
polymath_4.description: He draws on all 4 of his disciplines at once.

advisor_overhaul_effect_army_barrier.text: Barrier: %+n for all units in the army except characters

advisor_overhaul_effect_staff_and_sword_.text: "Bursting Bolts" (each staff shot fires five bolts that burst in a wide blue blast, sparing his own side)

advisor_overhaul_effect_sword_and_bow_ap.text: "Hunter's Spread" (each bow shot fires six lighter arrows in a glowing fan, each bursting in a small blast that spares his own side)
